met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Madhya Pradesh & adjoining Chhattisgarh at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Lakshadweep & adjoining southeast Arabian Sea at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Gulf of Mannar to North Interior Karnataka now runs from the cyclonic circulation over Lakshadweep & adjoining southeast Arabian Sea to Marathwada across north Kerala and interior Karnatakaat 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Sub-Himalayan West Bengalto South Interior Karnataka now runs from East Uttar Pradesh to Rayalaseema across East Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Telangana at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 74°E to the north of Lat. 32°N persists.
The trough from southwest Uttar Pradesh to Northwest Bay of Bengal across northeast Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh & Odisha at 1.5 km above mean sea level has been less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Uttarakhand and adjoining Himachal Pradesh at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Jharkhand & neighbourhood extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
